newsitem.title: UK: NWE regular firm, cargoes eye firmer U.S.Gulf trad.
newsitem.headline: NWE regular firm, cargoes eye firmer U.S.Gulf trad.

text.p: NWE gasoline barge prices were mixed. Traders said tight avails were firming prices for regular while thin buying interest softened Eurograde prices.

Continued weakness on NYMEX unleaded futures on Tuesday had hampered transatlantic arbitrage trade, but traders said the market continued to eye firmer U.S Gulf trade, where good buying from refiners, some of whom are in maintenance, has continued to boost prices despite the modest decline in NYMEX unleaded.
In ARA Eurograde barges traded slightly softer at $214 a tonne for R'dam. Regular was done slightly firmer at $207 fob R'dam. Traders said few Rotterdam majors had regular to offer.
